Every other amount on the filing was then re-checked against the widened band and none is clipped (the remaining figures are short). notes: PAGE-FACE candidate 'Timothy William Spencer' (handwritten), party 'Republican', Office Seeking written simply as 'Commissioner' with NO SEAT LETTER — index.csv carries 'County Commission Seat B' from the channel and that seat is NOT inferred or confirmed by this document; index.csv names no candidate, so the page face supplies it. Report type: the INTERIM box '30 Days after withdraw or elimination' is ticked; the amendment question is answered 'No'; signed and dated 04-23-18, and the same date is written in the Date of Report box on all three inner sheets. The document is stamped 'COPY' and the clerk's 'Date received' box is EMPTY — there is no received stamp on this copy. FORM STOCK (§H5): the cover is the county-only title 'FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES (Utah County Code 2-5 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5)' and the three inner sheets are GENUINELY 2018-DATED, strap-lined '2018 County Candidate' (summary and Schedule B) and '2018 County CandidateS' (Schedule A) — the same two-wording 2018 stock seen on the Ellingson filing in this chunk, no 2016 leftover. Schedule B's payee column is headed 'Provider/Vendor' and there is NO Purpose column. A NEW FOLIATION PRACTICE, worth recording against the eight already catalogued: this filer increments the TOTAL along with the page, writing 'Page 2 of 2' on the summary, 'Page 3 of 3' on Schedule A and 'Page 4 of 4' on Schedule B, while ALSO hand-numbering the four sheets '- 1 -' to '- 4 -' at the foot including the cover. Read naively, the summary's 'of 2' would say the schedules do not exist; the hand pagination and the pages themselves say otherwise. Page ordinals and foliation locate nothing here — the summary page was located by its printed 'SUMMARY PAGE' heading. FILER HABIT: every figure on the summary page is written once in its cell and then RE-WRITTEN in parentheses beside or below it — (748.31) appears five times — and the schedules' subtotals are written the same way ('748.31 (748.31)'). The repetition is the filer's own confirmation, not a second figure, and both writings agree everywhere. THE TWO SCHEDULES MIRROR EACH OTHER: the same eight amounts in the same order, because this filer records each out-of-pocket payment as a contribution from himself AND as the expenditure it funded; contributions therefore equal expenditures exactly and the beginning and closing balances are slashed zeros (0 under the zero-glyph ruling). ROW-INDEX TRAPS SCREENED: no skipped first line (the §A1 control crop rendered the row-1 figure on both schedules), no banner, no voided row, no continuation line, the §B5 one-past control rendered an empty cell on both pages, and no rowbands band was ~2x pitch, so no doubled band (§H3) exists here; each side's sum closed on its own printed subtotal without any shortfall to explain. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: columns assigned by CONTENT and confirmed against the printed headings — dates in Date, person/business names in Name-of-Contributor and Provider/Vendor, addresses in the address column, money in Amount; no inversion of the §F2/§G3 kind. PRIVACY: this filing is not one of the county's redacted publications; donor and vendor mailing lines are printed in the clear and were reduced at read time — the candidate's own city/state only on the contribution side (from the 'above' pointer his own cells make to the cover), and NOTHING on the expenditure side, which carries no address field in this record.
